Balance sheet-

Property plant and equipment includes Right of use of assets value of INR 398 crores
Other non-current assets include Current tax assets net non current of INR 785 crores
Non current lease liabilities are included under other non current financial liabilities
Other current financial liabilities include other financial liabilities and current lease labilities

Cash flow-
Other current assets movement includes both current and non current
Other financial assets movement includes both current and non current
Trade receivables movement include both current and non current
Other adjustments for which cash effects are investing or financing cash flow includes profit on redemption of mutual funds units and gain on disposal of property plant and equipment and investment property net.
Adjustments for decrease or increase in other trade receivables also includes loss allowance on trade receivables and other assets and other financial assets net of INR 3 crores
Other cash receipts from sales of equity or debt instruments of other entities and other cash payments to acquire equity or debt instruments of other entities includes amount relating to fixed deposits as well.
Exceptional items and recognized in statement of profit & loss are classified under other adjustments for non cash items
Interest received includes interest on indirect tax refund
Cash receipts from repayment of advances and loans made to other parties represents loans repayment by subsidiary and other parties
